svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 08/12 Eucalyptus Grove (Common)
svg.desc: Very tall trees on the west side of campus. The air smells like cough drops. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
